name: cause
doc: Root cause — use unknown when not established; grow this list as you read

name: change_type
doc: What kind of change this is (ISO/IEC/IEEE 14764 maintenance types). Reactive = corrective + adaptive; proactive = the rest.

name: device_type
doc: What type of input device is involved

name: dimension
doc: Which of ITIL 4's four dimensions the entry belongs to; the lens for a project-level assessment.

name: effort
doc: Relative size of the work (register entries only).

name: layer
doc: Where in the system the problem sits

name: pr_potential
doc: Actionability: how likely a PR could close this. Filled after reading; assessed for the current state of the fork (grenudi/input-remapper). This facet is the bridge between the dataset and the contribution plan.

name: risk
doc: Risk of the change breaking existing users, or of the situation if nothing is done (register entries only).

name: symptom
doc: What the reporter observed — weak labels derived from text; a search aid, not a diagnosis

name: value
doc: Relative benefit if the register entry is resolved (register entries only).
